title: StellarShift-Bench: Reliability Under Domain Shift in Stellar Spectroscopy
description: A reproducible benchmark for stellar-parameter accuracy, uncertainty calibration, domain adaptation, out-of-distribution detection, selective prediction, subgroup support, and physical plausibility under measurement-domain shift. Version 1.2.3 contains both a controlled DESI S/N reliability study and an executed, prespecified quality-gated LAMOST DR2 to DESI DR1 transfer on a shared APOGEE DR12 label scale, with paired adaptation effects, label-budget trials, calibration audits, support-overlap sensitivity, formal reference-label-error propagation, an atomic deterministic release build, and a portable Colab workflow with isolated SPARCL dependencies.
